name: pyroclear
tagline: Clear your terminal with a crackling ASCII flame wall
description: pyroclear replaces the boring clear command with a wall of crackling ASCII flame eating your old screen. It animates a flame effect that burns away the terminal output for a genuinely satisfying clearing experience. Written in Rust, it is a small, playful utility that adds personality to a tool developers run dozens of times a day. It is the kind of tiny, joyful project that makes a terminal feel alive.
highlights: Animated ASCII flame wall burns away terminal output
A satisfying replacement for the boring clear command
Written in Rust, fast and dependency-light
Adds personality to a command you run constantly
curatorNote: A tiny, purely joyful Rust utility that turns the most mundane shell command into a mini spectacle. Exactly the kind of hidden gem a 'curated gems' site exists to surface.
